pr.title: feat(cli): add `navi doctor` to report provider visibility
pr.body:
feat(cli): add `navi doctor` to report provider visibility

<!-- git-stk:description -->
`navi doctor` reports what each configured provider can actually see, so a silent-inbox problem surfaces before you wonder why navi is quiet.

For GitHub it does a live check: your identity, the orgs your token can see, whether team-detection scope (`read:org`) is present, and an SSO-authorization hint. Other providers get config-level sanity checks. This is what caught the muted-org gap earlier.

Closes #30.
<!-- /git-stk:description -->

<!-- git-stk:closes -->
Closes #30
<!-- /git-stk:closes -->
